main.subtitle: Mail
main.title: Mail
main.content: Read, organize, and respond to your emails from one centralized mailbox. Compose new messages, manage conversations, organize emails with labels and tags, and keep your inbox clean and easy to manage.

features.subtitle: Inbox
features.title: Stay on Top of Your Inbox
content: View and manage all your incoming emails from one organized inbox. Open messages to read complete email details and review previous conversations. Quickly identify important messages and keep track of your latest communication.
features.imageAlt: Stay on Top of Your Inbox

features.subtitle: Compose Mail
features.title: Compose and Send Emails
content: Create and send professional emails directly from your workspace. Add recipients, subject, message content, and attachments when needed. Keep your business communication simple, quick, and organized.

features.subtitle: Reply & Manage
features.title: Reply to Emails with Ease
content: Open any email to view its complete details and conversation history. Reply directly to messages and continue conversations from the same workspace. Manage emails efficiently without switching between different communication tools.

features.subtitle: Mail Boxes
features.title: Keep Your Mail Organized
content: Access all your emails through dedicated mailboxes for easier management. Use Inbox, Sent, Spam, and Trash to organize messages based on their status. Move unwanted or suspicious emails to Spam and keep your inbox clutter-free. Find sent and deleted messages quickly whenever you need them.

features.subtitle: Labels & Tags
features.title: Organize Emails Your Way
content: Use labels such as Archive and Important to organize emails based on their purpose. Create custom tags to categorize messages according to your workflow. Apply tags to quickly identify and group related emails.
